note: Laws in force on 1 January 2000. free_market: a liberal, open market economy with low business taxes, alongside national social partnership pay agreements. volunteer_force: the Defence Forces are an all-volunteer force and Ireland has no conscription. pluralist_secularism: there is no established state church, while most schools are run by religious bodies with state funding. national_health_service: public hospital and community care is tax-funded through the regional health boards, although many people also hold private health insurance; this is a judgement call between national_health_service and private_insurance. free_trade reflects EU single-market membership. open_internet and energy_mix are judgement calls for 2000.
